annotations.title: Prediction-market strike ladders on an instrument

description: Free public strike ladders: the prediction-market contracts written on one crypto, TradFi or index price (for example, will BTC be above $X at time T), grouped by expiry and settlement source, one ladder per venue series, soonest expiry first. Contract probability, bid and ask are venue prices in 0-100 points, never CoinRithm forecasts; tradedRecently:false is not a live price. Each ladder names its settlement source and referenceRelation (explained once in referenceNotes); observation is at_time or touch. No live price is included: reference names the series to read. Venue outcome ids are omitted; use detail=full or pm_data_event on the ladder's event. groups: [] means no contracts; coverage.degraded:true means the read failed. No API key required.

detail.description: summary (default) or the untouched record with venue outcome ids.

id.description: Coin slug such as bitcoin (the slug of a get_crypto_movers row, not its numeric coinId), or a ticker such as AAPL or SPX.

includeShortTerm.description: true adds up to 20 short-term up/down markets.

type.description: coin (id = coin slug), tradfi (catalog ticker), index (SPX, NDX), macro (none yet).

name: instrument_markets
